frequency_question: How often does a central bank raise a dormant countercyclical capital buffer above zero during a non-crisis expansionary window?
membership_rule: Includes formal establishment and active adjustment phases of the Basel III countercyclical capital buffer or direct systemic risk buffers by G-SIB regulators since 2016. Excludes pandemic-related emergency reductions or purely mechanical formulaic automatic stabilizers.
